info.title: CashKr Admin API — Devices & Pricing 1
info.description: Tags: brands, camera-lens, check-model-code, classes, device-classes

get.description:
Returns brand rows filtered by device type, brand name or free-text search, with sorting and a pagination envelope.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. Pagination is cosmetic: skip/take are never applied, so every matching row is returned and pagination.pages equals the total count.

_Source: `app/api/brands/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: deviceType
parameters.description: Prisma DeviceType filter

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search across brandName, title and description

parameters.name: brandName
parameters.description: Case-insensitive brandName contains-filter

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Echoed back in the pagination object only

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Column to sort by

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: asc | desc

post.description:
Creates a brand row for a device type. All six fields are mandatory.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. Audited via withAuditLog as BRAND.

_Source: `app/api/brands/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

example.title: Sell old Apple mobile
example.description: Get the best price for your used iPhone.

put.description:
Full replace of a brand row. The id travels in the JSON body, not the URL, and every field is mandatory.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. Unlike DELETE, the id is NOT parsed to an int here. Audited via withAuditLog as BRAND.

_Source: `app/api/brands/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

example.title: Sell old Apple mobile
example.description: Get the best price for your used iPhone.

delete.description:
Hard-deletes the brand whose numeric id is given in the query string.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check - unauthenticated hard delete. Audited via withAuditLog as BRAND.

_Source: `app/api/brands/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Brand id. Required - 400s when missing. Parsed with parseInt.

patch.summary: Update a single field on a brand
patch.description:
Generic single-column patch: writes `value` into the column named by `field` on the brand with the given id. Used for inline table edits.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. The `field` name is NOT whitelisted - it is used directly as a Prisma column key, so any writable column on brands can be set. Audited via withAuditLog as BRAND.

_Source: `app/api/brands/field/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

get.summary: List unique brand names for a device type
get.description:
Returns the distinct (case-insensitively deduplicated) brand names available for one device type, sorted alphabetically. Used to populate brand dropdowns.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/brands/list/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: deviceType
parameters.description: Prisma DeviceType, e.g. Mobile, Laptop, Tablet, Mac, Watch, Camera, Console, Headphone. Required - 400s when missing.

get.description:
Paginated list of the CameraLens price table (brand, lensName, flat rupee value) used by the quote engine to add lens value on top of a camera body price.

**Notes:** NextAuth session required. This table is live and consumed by the customer app/website for camera quoting.

_Source: `app/api/camera-lens/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, clamped to a minimum of 1

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page, clamped to 1-100

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search across lensName and brand

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Exact (case-insensitive) brand filter

post.description:
Adds a lens add-on price. Rejects a duplicate brand+lensName pair with 409 so the quote engine never sees two prices for one lens.

**Notes:** NextAuth session required. Affects live customer-facing camera quotes. Audited via withAuditLog as PRODUCT.

_Source: `app/api/camera-lens/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

example.error: brand, lensName and a numeric value are all required
A lens "EF 50mm f/1.8 STM" already exists for Canon.

put.description:
Partial update of a lens row - only the supplied fields are written. The id travels in the JSON body.

**Notes:** NextAuth session required. Unlike POST there is no duplicate check here, so a rename can create two rows for the same lens. Affects live customer quotes. Audited via withAuditLog as PRODUCT.

_Source: `app/api/camera-lens/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

delete.description:
Hard-deletes the lens row identified by the ?id query parameter.

**Notes:** NextAuth session required. Removing a lens changes live customer-facing camera quotes. Audited via withAuditLog as PRODUCT.

_Source: `app/api/camera-lens/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Lens id. Required - 400s when missing or non-numeric.

get.summary: Get next model-code sequence for a prefix
get.description:
Finds the highest existing model code starting with the given prefix in the device table for the device type and returns the next sequence number. Returns 100001 when no code matches yet.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. The sequence is read from the last 6 characters of the highest code; Drone and TV store the column as 'modelcode' (lowercase c) while the rest use 'modelCode'. There is no reservation, so two concurrent callers can get the same number.

_Source: `app/api/check-model-code/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Model code prefix to sequence. Required - 400s when missing.

parameters.name: deviceType
parameters.description: One of Mobile, Tablet, Laptop, Mac, Console, Camera, Watch, Headphone, AC, Drone, TV. Desktop is intentionally unsupported. Required - 400s when missing or unknown.

get.summary: List grading classes for a device table
get.description:
Returns every row of one device-class table (the condition/grade tiers used in quoting), ordered by id.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. The table list is a hard-coded switch, so device types outside the eight listed are not supported.

_Source: `app/api/classes/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: tableName
parameters.description: Which class table to read; matched case-insensitively. One of classMobile, classTablet, classLaptop, classMac, classWatch, classCamera, classHeadphone, classConsole. Required - 400s when missing or unknown.

get.summary: List device classes for a device type
get.description:
Paginated, sortable list of class rows (deduction tables) for one device type, optionally filtered by class id or a case-insensitive classType substring.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/device-classes/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: deviceType
parameters.description: Device type. 400 if missing; an unknown value throws and returns 500.

parameters.name: classType
parameters.description: Case-insensitive contains filter on classType.

parameters.name: classId
parameters.description: Exact class row id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Column to order by.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: asc or desc.

post.description:
Creates a new deduction class for a device type. Pricing fields are mapped per device type (Mobile/Tablet take A/W/S/P/T/B, Console takes CD/E/P/A, etc.) and stored as strings; unknown fields for the type are dropped.

**Notes:** A warnings array is returned when a whole critical deduction group (W2+, B2+, S2+) is zero. Console must NOT be sent CD0/E0/P0. No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/device-classes/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

warnings: All Screen deductions (S2, S3, S4, S5) are set to 0

example.error: Class M1 already exists for device type Mobile

put.description:
Replaces the class metadata and the full per-device-type pricing map for an existing class row.

**Notes:** Any pricing column you omit is reset to '0' because the body map defaults it. No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/device-classes/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

delete.description:
Deletes the class row identified by the id and deviceType query params.

**Notes:** Destructive and unauthenticated; devices referencing the class will lose their pricing.

_Source: `app/api/device-classes/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Class row id.

parameters.name: deviceType
parameters.description: Device type whose class table to delete from.

patch.summary: Update one field on a device class
patch.description:
Inline-edit endpoint that writes a single column on the class table for the given device type. Pricing columns accept a flat amount ('500') or a percentage ('10%'); credit, deadPrice, tier and a few zero-tier columns are strict integers.

**Notes:** Directly mutates pricing used to quote customers. Integer-only pricing columns: Watch.P0 and Console.CD0/E0/P0. No handler-level auth check (audit-logged only when a session exists).

_Source: `app/api/device-classes/field/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

400.description: Missing fields or invalid price format

example.error: 'abc' is not a valid price. Enter a flat amount like 500, or a percentage like 10%.
Failed to update device class field

SuccessErrorDetailsEnvelope.description: Error envelope `{ success: false, error, details }` where `details` is a string.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Plain error envelope `{ error }` used by most routes. `error` is a human-readable message.

id.description: Lens id. Required - 400s when missing or non-numeric.

value.description: New flat rupee add-on; must be non-negative

field.description: Column name to update, e.g. title, description, brandLink, brandImg

deviceType.description: Device type whose class table to write

classType.description: Class name, must be unique for the type

credit.description: Credit points charged to a vendor for this class

W1.description: Warranty deduction; flat amount or percentage. Same for W2-W4, B1-B4, S1-S5, A1-A8, P1-P16, T1-T15, CD1-CD10, E1-E8, R1-R4, D1-D3 depending on device type
Pricing column; all mapped columns for the device type are written, missing ones become '0'

id.description: Class row id (numeric strings are coerced)

deviceType.description: Mobile, Tablet, Laptop, Camera, Headphone, Console, Drone, TV, AC, Desktop, Mac or Watch

field.description: Column name, e.g. W2, B3, classType, credit, deadPrice, tier

value.description: New value. Pricing fields must match a flat amount or percentage; empty string means no deduction

MessageEnvelope.description: Message-only envelope `{ message }`; used for both success and failure responses.

value.description: Flat rupee amount added to the camera quote. Must be a non-negative number.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthenticated - no valid admin session (NextAuth cookie), or the expected token/secret is missing or wrong. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie from logging in to the admin panel. On HTTPS the cookie name is `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`.

cronBearer.description: `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token — every cron job goes through `assertCronAuth` in `lib/linode/cron-auth.ts`, which reads only this variable (despite some jobs being non-Linode).

unverifiedAccessToken.name: Authorization
unverifiedAccessToken.description: Legacy customer routes: an `accessToken` cookie or an `Authorization` header must be PRESENT, but the value is never verified. Not real authentication.

adsWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
adsWebhookSecret.description: `ADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, sent either as the `x-webhook-secret` header or as a `secret` field in the JSON body. If the env var is unset the route rejects every call with 401 (it does not fall through to unauthenticated access).

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Generic `x-webhook-secret` header check for an inbound webhook.

cronSecretBearer.description: `CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token, compared with `bearerMatches` in `lib/auth/secret-compare.ts`. Distinct from `cronBearer`, which uses `LINODE_CRON_SECRET`.
